warning.titlePre: Mercedes S350d Swirl Flap & Injector Wear
paragraphs: If your S350d is a pre-2020 model with the OM642 diesel V6 — that's the W221 or W222 generation — swirl flap and injector wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, backed by multiple manufacturer technical service bulletins. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

The newer W223 generation uses a different engine, the OM656, which doesn't share this specific issue — it's a separate, more recent design with its own occasional injector seal wear at higher mileage, but nothing as consistently documented as the older engine's swirl flap pattern.
warning.source: Source: established specialist pattern, multiple TSBs, per VRF-mercedes-s-class.md. OM656 explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to generation
